title: Better Life Modpack
description: Better Life is a high-performance 1.21.4 Fabric modpack that blends elite optimization features. Experience a smoother, more immersive Minecraft with dynamic seasons and hundreds of quality-of-life improvements.
body:
🌟 Better Life Modpack (1.21.4 - Fabric)

Optimized for multiplayer gameplay.

Better Life is a meticulously curated Fabric modpack designed for Minecraft 1.21.4. It redefines the gameplay experience by focusing on extreme performance, modern quality-of-life (QoL) improvements, and deep immersion. While staying true to the "Vanilla+" spirit, this pack ensures every interaction is smoother, more beautiful, and more intuitive.

🚀 Key Features
Peak Performance: Powered by Sodium, Iris, ImmediatelyFast, and BadOptimizations. Designed to provide high FPS and zero stuttering, even on lower-end systems.

Immersive World: Experience dynamic seasonal changes with Serene Seasons, realistic weather with Immersive Thunder/Snow, and lifelike movements with Not Enough Animations.

Creative Building: Massive architectural options with Macaw’s Furniture, Bridges, and Stairs. Manage your loot with Traveler’s Backpack and Storage Delight.

Quality of Life: Features like FallingTree (timber), Veinminer, Right Click Harvest, and Mouse Tweaks remove the tedious grind and let you focus on creativity.

Navigation & Maps: Never lose your way with Xaero’s Minimap and World Map. Locate biomes and structures with Nature’s and Explorer's Compass.

Social & Interaction: Simple Voice Chat for proximity talk, Emotecraft for gestures, and Chat Heads to bring personality to your multiplayer sessions.

📜 Credits & Acknowledgments
(Credits that are missing from this list are listed in the mod pack's menu.) Better Life is built upon the incredible work of the Minecraft modding community. We extend our deepest gratitude to the following developers:

Core Frameworks: The Fabric Team, Architectury, and Cloth Config.

Performance Wizards: CaffeineMC (Sodium/Iris), ImmediatelyFast Team, and FerriteCore.

Design & UI Specialists: Macaw (Furniture/Bridges), Xaero (Maps), Vazkii (AppleSkin), and the REI Team.

Immersion Creators: Serene Seasons Team, Tr7zw (3D Skin Layers), and Henkelmax (Voice Chat).

Note: All mods remain the intellectual property of their respective authors. This pack follows all distribution licenses provided by the creators.

❓ Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
Q: How much RAM should I allocate for this modpack?
A: We recommend allocating at least 4GB of RAM. For the best experience with high-end shaders, 6GB is recommended.

Q: Is this modpack server-compatible?
A: Yes! While many mods are client-side only, features like Simple Voice Chat and Serene Seasons require the pack to be installed on both the server and the client to function correctly.

Q: How do I access the Minimap and World Map?
A: By default, press 'Y' for Minimap settings and 'M' to open the Full World Map.

Q: Are Shaders supported?
A: Absolutely. Iris Shaders is pre-installed. Simply go to Video Settings -> Shader Packs and drag your preferred shader .zip file into the menu.

Q: What makes "Better Life" different?
A: It is built for 1.21.4 with a focus on stability and performance. We don't just add mods; we optimize the game to make it feel like a modern, professional title.

Made With love!
